result:
Both order problems are fixed: A21 and the A20 keyboard test now pass after A12 and at the end of a full run, in default and reverse file order, in chromium-en and chromium-ar. The full runs are still not all green, because two open product defects (P-1 and P-2) fail in every order. I found no new defect, and the DG5 validator exited 0 at the start and at the end.

This was an authoring task, not a gate review. The changes are uncommitted, and I edited no product source. The handback is at `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/T-DG6-QA-G-authoring/handback.md`, with the logs beside it.

**What caused each problem and how I fixed it**
- **Q-1 (A21 "AI is off" check fails after A12):** I reproduced it on this HEAD with the unchanged specs, in both languages. A12 already switched the assistant off afterwards, but a saved setting stays "configured". The product has no way to remove one, and its history can't be deleted. So I changed the A21 check instead. Its requirement text is about "a fresh install", so it now builds its own fresh install (new database, migrate, seed, the built API) next to the shared stack and checks that.
  - No assertion was weakened. I added two database checks: no saved assistant setting and no setting history on the fresh install.
  - A21's second test now checks its own precondition (no email channel configured or enabled) instead of assuming it.
  - A12 now puts the assistant back to whatever on/off state it found, and checks that it did.
- **Q-2 (A20 keyboard test fails in Arabic):** the earlier guess (the assistant button adding a stop) was wrong. The test tried to restart Tabbing from the top by focusing the page body, which does nothing. So it Tabbed through all of My Work for `dev.lead`, which collects items from every earlier spec, and ran past its 200-stop limit by the end of a full run. The test now reloads the page and Tabs from the top, with the same limit and the same checks.

**Results**

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Integration suite (acceptance 1) | 1 | 430/431 tests, 43/44 files pass. The one failure is P-1; every A12, A20 and A21 file passes. |
| Unit suite | 0 | 35/35 |
| Full root e2e, default order | 1 | 158 passed, 4 failed, 18 skipped |
| Full root e2e, reverse order | 1 | 158 passed, 4 failed, 18 skipped |
| A12 → A20 → A21 with the final files | 1 | 28 passed, 2 failed (A12-5 only) |
| A21 with the outbound-connection log | 0 | 4/4; every connection stayed on the local machine |
| Accessibility (axe) | — | 0 serious or critical issues on every page reached |
| `pnpm lint` and the prettier check | 0 | clean |

- In both full runs, the 4 failures are A12-5 and the A17 failing-connector test, in each language. The 18 skips are the A20 accessibility spec's own design: 9 screens per language have no test data.
- My first reverse run was killed by my shell's 30-minute background limit, not by a test. I re-ran it in full with a longer limit; that rerun is the reverse row above.
- I added the A21 precondition check after the default full run had already loaded its tests. That run therefore used the earlier version of A21, but the final version passed in the reverse run, the A12 → A20 → A21 run and the connection-log run. The handback records the file hashes for each run.

**Mutation checks:** I broke the behaviour behind five central assertions in a disposable copy: the fresh install ships with the assistant configured; the same with the database checks removed; the fresh install ships with it switched on; the A12 user is also given access to Y; and the language switch is taken out of the keyboard order. All five tests failed as they should. Unchanged copies of the A21 and A20 specs passed.

**Requirement table:** all 34 DG6 rows citing A12, A20 or A21 are mapped in the handback. Most pass. Not covered by my suites:
- REQ-S15-014 and REQ-S17-008.
- The draft-reload clauses of REQ-S02-006 and REQ-S15-010 (frontend specs I didn't run).
- REQ-S16-007 is BLOCKED: there is no Keycloak in this sandbox.
- REQ-DLV-038 fails on this tree because of P-1 and P-2, and has to be re-run on the frozen DG6 candidate.

**Findings**
- **P-1 (A17, REQ-S12-019), open product defect:** after a test connector fails, the linked KPI reports its freshness as "unknown" with no last value, instead of "Stale" with its last value and date. It fails in integration and e2e, in both languages.
- **P-2 (A12-5, REQ-S17-007), open product defect:** with the assistant on, the user scoped to transformation X never sees the assistant button. The settings read returns 403 for that user, while the assistant's own API returns 200. A12-5 fails every time in both languages, so that row stays SPECIFIED.
- **Q-1 and Q-2 (Low, test isolation):** fixed and proven in both orders and both languages.

**Files written**
- `e2e/support/fresh-install.ts` (new)
- `e2e/support/run-spec-order.sh` (new): Playwright always runs files in name order, so this script is the only way to get a reverse run.
- `e2e/a21-p6-degradation.spec.ts`, `e2e/a12-p6-scope-isolation.spec.ts` and `e2e/a20-p6-ux.spec.ts` (changed)

Everything else is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/T-DG6-QA-G-authoring/`.
